slice: stock tires from Suzuki spec pages and owner's manuals (gap fill)
method: Stock tires per roster bike-year where BAK had no stock tire size and model yet (checked against every docs/research/knowledge file on 2026-11-07). Read from the bike maker's owner's manual or spec page; printed values kept as printed, odd ones noted.

records.topic: 2024 Suzuki RM-Z250: stock tire sizes and models
records.statement: Suzuki lists the 2024 RM-Z250 with an 80/100-21 51M front and 100/90-19 57M rear (tube type) fitted with Dunlop Geomax MX33 tires; the 2024 owner's manual gives MX33F front and MX33 rear and a cold pressure range of 70–110 kPa (10–16 psi).
records.notes: 2024 tire models and pressure also from Suzuki's 2024 RM-Z250 owner's manual 99011-46K55 (read from a copy in BAK's research store; no public URL recorded).

records.topic: 2024 Suzuki RM-Z450: stock tire sizes and models
records.statement: Suzuki's 2024 RM-Z450 owner's manual lists an 80/100-21 51M front and 110/90-19 62M rear, Bridgestone Battlecross X30F front and X30R rear, at 70–110 kPa (10–16 psi) cold.
records.notes: Read from a copy of the owner's manual in BAK's research store; Suzuki does not publish owner's manuals online (no public URL).

records.statement: Suzuki lists the 2025 RM-Z450 with an 80/100-21 51M front and 110/90-19 62M rear (tube type).
Suzuki lists the 2026 RM-Z450 with an 80/100-21 51M front and 110/90-19 62M rear (tube type).

records.topic: 2027 Suzuki RM-Z450: stock tire sizes and models
records.statement: Suzuki lists the 2027 RM-Z450 with an 80/100-21 51M front and 110/90-19 62M rear (tube type), fitted with Bridgestone Battlecross X30 tires.
records.notes: The 2027 RM-Z450 page also carries a paragraph about the RM-Z250's new Dunlop MX34 tires; the RM-Z450's own text names Bridgestone Battlecross X30.
